preconditions.description: The input n must be a non-negative integer representing the number of nodes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(numTrees(i) * numTrees(n - 1 - i) for i in range(n)) if n > 0 else 1
postconditions.description: The return value equals the nth Catalan number, computed recursively as the sum of products of left and right subtree counts for all possible root choices, with base case 1 for n=0.
The output must be a positive integer representing the count of unique BST structures.
